headline: Data center stocks under pressure
detail: The plunge in a Korea IPO signals weakness in the data center space. This could impact your tech holdings, especially those tied to infrastructure or cloud services.
rec: Consider trimming exposure to any data center-related names if you hold them, given this sector-wide pressure.

headline: Salesforce AI purchase cost concerns
detail: Investors are reacting negatively to the cost of Salesforce's latest AI acquisition. This highlights a potential shift in sentiment around AI spending and valuations.
rec: Watch how this impacts other AI-focused tech names. It could signal a broader re-evaluation of AI stock valuations.

headline: Oil prices fall on diplomatic hopes
detail: Easing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East could reduce energy price volatility. This is generally positive for the broader market, but may not directly impact your tech-heavy book.
rec: This headline is unlikely to have a direct, immediate impact on your specific tech and chip holdings.
